entry.title: Demo
entry.content:
Welcome to My New Blog Setup

This is my very first official entry! I am writing this post entirely in standard Markdown text inside my isolated repository space.

Why I Like This Setup

  • No Raw HTML Needed: I can just type my thoughts freely.
  • Separation of Concerns: My main website files stay completely untouched.
  • Automation: The compiler converts this file into an HTML file on its own.

Hope you enjoy reading!
